name: ai-workbench
description: AI 工作台 —— Electron + React + TypeScript + Vite 桌面应用 + Fastify/PostgreSQL 最小后端（npm workspaces monorepo）

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ai-workbench/shared && npm run dev -w @ai-workbench/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-workbench/shared && npm run build -w @ai-workbench/desktop && npm run build -w @ai-workbench/server
scripts.start: npm run build -w @ai-workbench/shared && npm run start -w @ai-workbench/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build -w @ai-workbench/shared && npm run package -w @ai-workbench/desktop
scripts.package:dir: npm run build -w @ai-workbench/shared && npm run package:dir -w @ai-workbench/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-workbench/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ai-workbench/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @ai-workbench/server
